D/ IVL CRISP-VS NOB C ; R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Caesarum Nostrorum, Reece period 16, London mint, issue of 323-324, RIC volume 7 no. 291. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: IVL CRISP-VS NOB C. Reverse description: Wreath around vow: VOT / X. Reverse inscription: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. In exergue: PLON, for London mint.
